changelog:
Initial release of quit-porn skill:

- Track your sobriety streak in real-time.
- Manage urges with practical tools and support.
- Celebrate milestones at key recovery intervals (1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 1 year).
- View personal progress insights, patterns, and triggers.
- All data remains private and local on your device.
summary: Break free from porn addiction with streak tracking, urge management, and recovery milestones
